title: My Busy Week
text:
My week is busy. On Monday and Tuesday I go to school. On Wednesday I have an English class. On Thursday I play football with my friend.

On Friday I stay at home and read. On Saturday I go to the park with my family. On Sunday we visit my grandmother. I like the weekend very much.

questions.text: What do I do on Wednesday?
options: I stay at home and read

questions.text: Who do we visit on Sunday?
How does the writer feel about the weekend?
options: The writer is happy about it
The writer is bored by it
The writer is afraid of it
The writer does not think about it

questions.text: Which day is probably the most relaxing for the writer?

vocabulary.definition: having a lot of things to do
the mother of your mother or father
the people you are related to, such as parents and children
a large public garden where people can walk and relax

paragraph_translations: Mój tydzień jest zajęty. W poniedziałek i wtorek chodzę do szkoły. W środę mam lekcję angielskiego. W czwartek gram w piłkę nożną z kolegą.
W piątek zostaję w domu i czytam. W sobotę idę z rodziną do parku. W niedzielę odwiedzamy babcię. Bardzo lubię weekend.
